Wanting payback for their earlier loss, Lee and Ray accept the two-on-two challenge and the match format is set. F Dynasty dominates the contest, causing Lee to go batty in fear of letting Ray down yet again. Coming loose at the seams, Lee's reckless blading becomes a serious concern. To save his fragile-minded teammate from further distress, Ray knocks out Lee's blade himself and accept his team's loss. Discussing the incident afterward, Lee acknowledges his mistake, and he and Ray vow to be more communicative in the future.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As Max prepares to face Kai in the next round, the members of BBA Revolution overhear a confrontation between Johnny and Robert of the Majestics and Barthez Battalion. It turns out Barthez Battalion won their qualifying tournament through trickery. Thanks to Kenny, the teams find proof of Barthez's underhanded tactics but it's too late to disqualify them from the Championships. Armed with his new Draciel Gravity, Max takes Kai to the edge of defeat only to end up defeated himself. Rick uses his frustration at the loss to overcome Tala and goes on to face Kai in a tiebreaker. Despite his great power, Rick loses to the more experienced Kai. Inspired by the match, Tyson vows to face Barthez Battalion with everything he's got.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BBA Revolution are slated to face the sneaky Barthez Battalion, but while Hilary and Kenny want to report their dirty deeds to the authorities, Tyson believes the best way to teach them a lesson is to beat them fair and square'But that's before he really sees how low the team will sink to win. When Mathilda blows up her beyblade on purpose, just to cause damage to Daichi's Strata Dragoon, Tyson and his team are shocked'But Tyson stands his ground! Although Daichi wants to give Jean Paul Barthez himself a piece of his mind'Tyson holds him back, knowing that all will be decided in the beyblade dish'or will it? Tyson prepares to face off against Miguel, but how will he fare against the team leader's own dirty tricks'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes land in Egypt for the next leg of the tournament where the first two teams going up against each other are the Blitzkrieg Boys against the Barthez Battalion. But as Barthez readies his team, we learn he's devised a special spider web-like tape that is supposed to shoot out of his team's blades and trap their opponents in an inescapable web. Miguel is torn and knows that if they follow his coach's plan they could win, but he feels he'd rather lose with respect than cheat. In the first battle, Aaron goes up against Tala. Barthez tells his players to just act natural and he would operate the spider webbing by remote control. As the battle begins, Barthez desperately pushes the remote control, but nothing happens. Turns out Aaron refused to use the 'fixed' blade. Barthez is furious. Miguel is defiant and tell Barthez that they aren't going to be 'his puppets anymore.' As Barthez leaves, Miguel steps into the ring against Kai. The battle doesn't last very long as Kai wins handily. But Miguel has lost with dignity and that's just the way he wants it!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is having trouble convincing Rick that he is truly dedicated to the PPB All Starz. Max just wants to play for love of the game but Rick thinks he should do anything to win. When the competition continues Max demands they fight a 'pairs' match so that he and Rick are forced to work as a team. Rick's ego gets the best of him and soon he finds himself not only battling the White Tiger X team but Max as well. Mariah tells Ray and Lee of White Tiger X that they should battle each other and find out who is the best blader out of the four of them. A beyblading free for all ensues until the final climactic battle when only one blade is left spinning. The winner is surprised as everyone else to learn that he is the best blader of them all!'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Egyptian leg of the World Championships culminates with the final match highlighting F Dynasty against the BBA Revolution. The day before the match, Tyson has Daichi practice moves with him that they're not usually accustomed to doing: namely, tag-team attacks. F Dynasty is renowned for their tag-team abilities, and Tyson wants nothing more than to beat them at their own game. He knows this will be a challenge, as F Dynasty has already used the tag-team format to defeat White Tiger X earlier in the tournament. But as the former Beyblade world champion, Tyson feels it's his duty to prove that he's the best, no matter what the format is. F Dynasty meanwhile, foregoes practicing in favor of another fantastic street show of their beyblading skills for a crowd of onlookers. In a flashback to their childhood, we learn that Raul and Julia have been performing as a duo since their formative years growing up in the circus. The introduction of beyblades to their act only solidified their skills. When the day of the match arrives, Tyson specifically requests the two-on-two format and F Dynasty agrees. The sand-filled Sahara dish gives Tyson and Daichi the pre-battle advantage, but during the match, Tyson's beyblade has trouble keeping up. Coach Hiro realizes that the pressure Tyson is feeling to carry his team as the former Beyblade champion is affecting his performance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is feeling the pressure of being World Champion. Despite Hiro's warning, a television crew follows him around for a day, taping his every move. Daichi feels jealous and tries to compete for the camera's attention. Finally, BBA Revolution holds a three-way match between Tyson, Daichi and Kenny for the cameras and Tyson loses like an amateur. Tyson contemplates quitting and wanders to the Beystadium to be alone with his thoughts. Daichi confronts him and challenges him to a match. During the beybattle, Tyson is reminded of how it feels to beyblade for the pure love of the game. The pressure disappears when Tyson realizes he doesn't have to beyblade like a champion. He just has to beyblade like himself! Tyson meets Kai, Max and Ray ands tells them that, from now on, they are all challengers and any one of them could end up as champion.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final elimination round is underway, with F Dynasty trying to earn the last play-off slot, while their opponents, the already mathematically eliminated Barthez Battalion try to spoil their chances. Feeling like the weak link of the team, Raul surprises Julia by insisting he battle solo for F Dynasty, in order to prove his worth. Julia reluctantly agrees. In the first match Julia easily defeats Miguel, piling even more pressure on Raul. Raul is up against Mathilda of Barthez Battalion (who is using a combination of parts from her team's Beyblades) in the second match. Raul freezes under the pressure, and it looks like he is a sitting duck. But Julia steps in to explain to Raul that the only reason she has so much confidence in battle is because she has him at her side. This fires Raul up, and he battles back to steal the victory. The Barthez Battalion team are eliminated, but they are very gracious in defeat.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With Lee losing to Tala early in the match, White Tiger X is a game down, and Kai now steps up to battle for the Blitzkrieg Boys. This round is sure to be intense, as old teammates face off in the dish. Ray will represent White Tiger X, and the world is watching. The pressure seems too much for the players, as Ray collapses from the strain. Somehow he finds the strength to keep going, and the desire to bring Kai down! The intensity rises as the battle continues, with both players on either side of the dish so evenly matched, who can predict which one will walk away with the victory?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The fight is a tough one. In fact, the combatants are going at it so hard that the entire arena is filled with the acrid smell of burnt metal. This seems to be a battle of wills rather than blades as each Blader attempts to summon every ounce of power that they can. In the end, Daichi proves to be the winner, and Rick is devastated. Daichi on the other hand has used so much energy that he passes out. Now it's time for the next round, and it pits Tyson against his former teammate, Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Max face off against each other in the semi-final of the World Beyblading Championships. The two old friends use two totally different blading styles in the dish. Tyson takes the offense while Max hangs back and chooses for a more defensive style. Tyson has a tough time battling Max and when Dragoon starts to lose power he starts his engine gear. When he goes in for the final hit, Max suddenly goes on the offense and starts Draciel's engine gear. Just when it looks like Dragoon is going to be knocked out Tyson cleverly uses Draciel's own power against it and defeats Max! This allows Tyson's team, the BBA Revolution, to move on to the final round of the competition!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three teams qualifying for the finals of the World Beyblade Championships ' the Blitzkrieg Boys, the BBA Revolution, and F Dynasty - the BBA must make a decision. Only two teams can play in the finals, and a format to determine which ones will compete must be decided. Will they stage a mini-round robin tournament between the three teams? Or will the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty, who are both tied for second place battle, with the winner moving on to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in the finals? These questions will all take time to answer - time the various competitors use to catch up with family members. With the PPB All Starz eliminated from the tournament, Max visits his folks and then drops by the local community center where he and Ray first told Tyson they were leaving the Bladebreakers. Tyson goes home to visit Grandpa, and Daichi tags along, making himself a little too at home in the process. Grandpa is impressed by Tyson's newfound seriousness when it comes to his martial arts training. Coach Romero of F Dynasty gives Raul and Julia a surprise when he brings them to visit the circus, which just happens to be in town. The circus is where the siblings grew up, and a heartfelt reunion ensues. At BBA Headquarters, Mr. Dickenson announces the finals format. The two second place teams will indeed face each other first, with the victor getting to advance. Tyson surprises everyone by requesting that his match be a tag-team battle. Kenny gives Tyson his newly created Dragoon Galaxy Turbo, an improved version of Dragoon, which performs well in tag-team practice. Tyson and Daichi are pumped - they couldn't be more ready for their upcoming rematch against F Dynasty.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The entire city is pumped for Tyson and Daichi's rematch with F Dynasty in double-team play. At first, the awesome power of BBA Revolution has Raul and Julia on their heels. Raul manages to save Julia from a stadium out and his big sister lets him take command. Encouraged by the support of their circus family, the brother and sister use their experience and teamwork to push the BBA Revolution to the brink of defeat. Tyson and Daichi are losing strength when they realize they are having the time of their lives. There's nothing like competing against powerful, skilled opponents. The BBA Revolution has one last shot at victory. Can Daichi and Tyson manage to use a risky move from F Dynasty's playbook to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? When Tyson's gambit wins the match, Raul and Julia are stunned to hear the crowd cheering for the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty! They are overwhelmed with pride as Kai leaves the stadium. At last, he will face Tyson for the World Championship.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon! Just when things look their bleakest, Kenny brings Dragoon back to its former glory, which gets Daichi off the hook! And now, instead of running away from Tala, he comes back with an intense attack! But is it too late to get back the advantage over his crafty opponent?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson. Kai shows up for the match battered and bruised from his training session with Spencer and Bryan, just so he can put himself at Tyson's level of physical exhaustion, since Tyson had already battled earlier in the day. Kai wants them to be evenly matched so that he won't have any advantage in battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: When most people think of deserts, we think of punishing heat, camels and rattlesnakes. But dig a little deeper, and unbelievable stories emerge, like a bleeding tree, and a desert filled with salt.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: We have always been fascinated by what lies beneath our feet. Some cultures have feared the underworlds, while others have believed that the earth houses our ancestors.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: Many cultures believe that human life began in the forest, and for that reason, a deep connection to the plants and animals is always treasured by those who live amongst the trees.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: The Latin phrase Terra firma means “solid earth”. From ancient history, man has utilized the Terra firma beneath his feet for many reasons but most strikingly to create homes out of the solid earth.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: Mountains provide a splendid backdrop for communities but they’re also important ecological landscapes. Approximately one-tenth of the world’s population depends on mountains for their life-support.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: Deserts. Forests. Caves. Mountains. How have human beings adapted to living in the world’s most extraordinary environments? The sheer magnificence of the natural world takes centre stage in this exploration of some of Earth’s most beautiful and most unforgiving environments and the people who have, against the odds, made these places their home.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: The French are famous for their haute cuisine with its extravagant presentations and complex techniques. After swimming with wild dolphins Brent meets with Michael Scioli, head chef at the prestigious hotel, Le Constance Prince Maurice on the east coast of the Island. Chef Michael shows him how to prepare a specialized French seafood dish using ingredients straight from the hotel's garden. Seeing as you can never have too much adventure, Brent then tries out fly and dive boarding (mainly dive) which is essentially a water powered jet pack. After an afternoon of fun, he limps into the hotel veggie garden to pick some ingredients for his own feast of French fusion prawns and coconut heart salad as the sun sets on anther beautiful day in paradise.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with an undersea walk before heading to Port Louis to meet Lloyd in Chinatown. A massive archway welcomes him onto the busy Chinatown streets and Brent and Lloyd whet their appetites with some Chinese street food. The Chinese influence on Mauritian food has been huge and there have been more than a few fusion dishes to come out of their Chinatown. Brent and Lloyd head to a local Chinese restaurant to try a popular dish that is unique to Mauritius, a Bol Renverse, an "upside-down bowl". After a delicious lunch Lloyd has a treat planned for Brent. He takes him to the Kwan Tee Pagoda, the oldest Pagoda in Mauritius and believed to be the oldest in the Southern Hemisphere. After a magical day Brent head's back to his hotel inspired and ready to cook up a storm. The next day Brent goes in search of ingredients in a local Chinese supermarket and then heads to a peaceful garden to cook his mustard pork with a twist.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Sugar is commonly known on the island as the Mauritian Miracle, having once been the backbone of Mauritius's economy. Brent visits L'Adventure du Sucre museum and gets a fascinating look at how the Mauritian history is tightly intertwined with sugar. He then heads in to the fields to for some fun cutting cane before meeting up with Chef Oliver and who shows Brent just how much Mauritians love sugar and spice. Brent then heads out to the stunning and exclusive island, Ile Des Deux Cocos, for some snorkeling in a marine sanctuary and then cooks up his own Mauritian tropical desert on a remote coral beach.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is covered in sugar cane plantations and Mauritian rum is growing fast on the international market. Brent heads to St Aubin, an estate with one of the oldest sugar cane fields and a factory that produces both artisanal and traditional rums. There he not only tastes the rum but learns all about making it too. It's a good thing he has nothing else planned that day. The next morning Brent visits a nearby market to buy his ingredients and then gets his adrenaline pumping with a wild tubing experience where he learns just how solid water is, again and again, and again. He then heads off on a sunset catamaran cruise where he cooks up a delicious caramel, rum, jerked chicken dish, finishing off the day with a rum cocktail. Is it the waves making him unsteady on his feet or all the rum?

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent looks back on his time in Mauritius. Everything he's learnt, the laughs, the people, the food. Co-existence amongst the Indian, African, European and Chinese locals has led to a sharing of cultures and values, giving the Mauritians a great sense of national pride and Brent can feel it. An island commonly associated with coconuts and cocktails is proven to be so much deeper and after being welcomed into homes, sacred places of worship and given family cooking secrets, Brent is left feeling like he is part of the Mauritian family.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se muestra perturbada ante la irrupción de Wilker en sus pensamientos ante el reproche de Yubiri Juan Diego se decide a acomodar lo acontecido con su frustrado compromiso para su beneficio al recordarle a Yubiri que cayo preso debido a su estadía en el barrio | Yubiri se deja halagar por la justificación de Juan Diego al retomar nuevamente su idea de haber sido la causa que permitió que el muchacho no se comprometiese | Juan Diego se aprovecha de la situación.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Luis Fernando llega a su casa y María Gracia le da la sorpresa de que Dileidy lo fue a buscar a su casa y Aureliano le dice a Dileidy lo mismo. María Gracia está por irse de modelo a Japón y antes de irse, le dice a Luis Fernando que busque a Dileidy.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska seduce a Ricardo, provocando el llanto de Manuela. En la junta, Benjamín Malaver intenta destituir a Ricardo, pero Manuela lo respalda y frustra el plan. María del Pilar es agredida y miente para protegerse. Celia invita a Moisés y su abuela a vivir con ella, enfrentando la oposición de Benjamín. Margot investiga la identidad real de Malaver. Finalmente, Manuela planea vender sus acciones para una clínica, mientras Katiuska vuelve a manipular a un confundido Ricardo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Dos mujeres campesinas rescatan a Rosa del encierro pero la abandonan en la montaña. Alejandro y José Luis son auxiliados por una grúa. Erasto es encontrado inconsciente y robado por campesinos. Rosa lo encuentra al borde del precipicio y arriesga su propia vida para salvarlo, sin saber que es el asesino de Carlos y el secuestrador. Erasto se arrepiente del atentado contra su vida. Marisela acepta el divorcio de Adolfo y aboga por Isaías en su empresa. Consuelo niega volver con Isaías. Natalia confiesa a René que está embarazada de Erasto y pide ayuda para abortar.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebecca se enfrenta a Agustina cuando esta la descubre con Edgar y le ofrece dinero, a Leonardo y a sus hijos a cambio de su silencio. Leonardo regaña a Julio por lo que hizo. Él le dice que se siente excluido de la familia y para remediarlo, Leonardo le ofrece trabajar en la empresa, siempre y cuando se disculpe con su hermano y le cuente la verdad a María Lucía. Virginia va a visitar a Carlos Ernesto y se reconcilian. Él le pide que vuelva a ser su secretaria. Jimena se reúne con Adolfo y le dice que no se casará con él, porque la prioridad son sus hijos. Jimena, después de la reunión con Adolfo, va a casa de Carlos Ernesto y le comunica su decisión, pero con la condición de que él vaya a la clínica a rehabilitarse.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro trata de acercarse a Sol y tener contacto amoroso, pero ella se resiste, dando por sentado que son hermanos. Es por esto que le pide a Aída que vuelva a vivir a la casa, para acercarse a Alejandro y ganar su amor. Aída sabe que esto no es cierto, sin embargo, Heriberto la llama, ya que si ella se queda con Alejandro, Sol buscará consuelo en él, entonces la amenaza, y si ella no cumple con eso, él buscará la manera de herir a Alejandro o a los niños.

Aída sabe que esto no es cierto, sin embargo, Heriberto la llama, ya que si ella se queda con Alejandro, Sol buscará consuelo en él, entonces la amenaza, y si ella no cumple con eso, él buscará la manera de herir a Alejandro o a los niños.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se muestra perturbada ante la irrupción de Wilker en sus pensamientos ante el reproche de Yubiri Juan Diego se decide a acomodar lo acontecido con su frustrado compromiso para su beneficio al recordarle a Yubiri que cayo preso debido a su estadía en el barrio | Yubiri se deja halagar por la justificación de Juan Diego al retomar nuevamente su idea de haber sido la causa que permitió que el muchacho no se comprometiese | Juan Diego se aprovecha de la situación.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Luis Fernando llega a su casa y María Gracia le da la sorpresa de que Dileidy lo fue a buscar a su casa y Aureliano le dice a Dileidy lo mismo. María Gracia está por irse de modelo a Japón y antes de irse, le dice a Luis Fernando que busque a Dileidy.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska seduce a Ricardo, provocando el llanto de Manuela. En la junta, Benjamín Malaver intenta destituir a Ricardo, pero Manuela lo respalda y frustra el plan. María del Pilar es agredida y miente para protegerse. Celia invita a Moisés y su abuela a vivir con ella, enfrentando la oposición de Benjamín. Margot investiga la identidad real de Malaver. Finalmente, Manuela planea vender sus acciones para una clínica, mientras Katiuska vuelve a manipular a un confundido Ricardo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Dos mujeres campesinas rescatan a Rosa del encierro pero la abandonan en la montaña. Alejandro y José Luis son auxiliados por una grúa. Erasto es encontrado inconsciente y robado por campesinos. Rosa lo encuentra al borde del precipicio y arriesga su propia vida para salvarlo, sin saber que es el asesino de Carlos y el secuestrador. Erasto se arrepiente del atentado contra su vida. Marisela acepta el divorcio de Adolfo y aboga por Isaías en su empresa. Consuelo niega volver con Isaías. Natalia confiesa a René que está embarazada de Erasto y pide ayuda para abortar.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene está dispuesta a comenzar una relación con Felipe aunque sus sentimientos le siguen perteneciendo a Leonardo. Rebeca puso los papeles de identidad de forma legal y vuelven a ser un matrimonio con Leonardo ante la ley, tramando un nuevo plan para que Leonardo firme un nuevo acta de matrimonio sin cláusula de separación de bienes que en actual tienen. Carlos Ernesto junto a sus abogados han encontrado pruebas forjadas sobre la culpabilidad de Virginia del caso de Miguel Ferrándiz, y Adolfo está preocupado porque se reabra el caso.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina le confirma a Alicia que ni ella ni Alejandro son hijos de Eloy. Alejandro al enterarse de que Alicia no es hija de Eloy le pide al médico que le confirme si es hermano de Sol. Este le dice que se lo dirá al otro día. Alejandro va con la noticia a Sol pero esta no quiere hacerse falsas ilusiones. Maricielo está a punto de confirmar que Alicia mandó a matar a Rómulo. Heriberto le pide a Anselmo que lo deje salir de la cárcel por una noche para tener intimidad con Sol.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la oficina de producción cinematográfica Graciela recibe la llegada de Gisela quien se muestra interesada en encontrarse con el Junior para comentar el guión de la película | Graciela escudriña en sus recuerdos al intentar memorizar la cara de Gisela al esta parecerle conocida con anterioridad | Gisela por su parte se confiesa abiertamente ante Graciela al tener la misma sensación de haber conocido a la muchacha con anterioridad | Junior interrumpe la conversación entre ambas mujeres.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Matilde se sincera con Pascua y le dice que Moncho y ella ya no están juntos, pero Pascua no se lo toma a bien y sabe que ella sabía que eso pasaría. Debido a la burla de Gonzalo, toda la oficina se entera que Matilde y Moncho no están más juntos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo y Manuela firman su divorcio. Ricardo entra en depresión y rechaza una fiesta organizada por Katiuska, mientras Celia celebra erróneamente creyendo que él le pedirá matrimonio. Manuela se muda al barrio y planea luchar por Glorita. Amparo, al cuidado de Moisés y la enfermera Laura Valentina, no logra comunicarse. Hortensia regresa de vacaciones y encuentra la casa en caos por los excesos de Katiuska, mientras intenta ayudar a un Ricardo que solo desea estar solo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: René celebra su graduación como médico. Carmen Rosa exige el alta del hospital para buscar a su hija. Arminda libera a Natalia creyendo a Erasto desaparecido. José Luis publica los crímenes de Erasto en la prensa. Vilma acosa a Salvador tras su ruptura. Adolfo descubre la campaña sucia en su contra y culpa a Erasto. Natalia pide a René acabar con su embarazo. Arminda consulta las piedras y ve la muerte de Erasto, anunciándola a Consuelo. En la carretera Rosa desorientada busca ayuda; Alejandro y José Luis la auxilian sorprendidos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo logra convencer a Irene de que lo acompañe a la empresa para poder resolver el problema con los documentos. Cuando llegan se encuentran con Alejandra, quien la culpa a Irene por todo el problema de papeleo que están teniendo. Irene intenta buscar por todas partes y llega a la conclusión de que alguien alteró la ubicación de esos archivos, por lo que, luego de recibir una segunda intimidación de Alejandra decide irse con Felipe, el cual no había podido tranquilizar a Mateo en la casa y decidió llevarlo hasta la empresa con la madre. Rodrigo se entera que están haciendo una reunión sin él y decide ir a participar de la misma por más que es solo para personal de confianza de la empresa.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol le dice a Heriberto que si ella resulta ser hermana de Alejandro, se entregará a él, por lo que Madroño planifica un escape de la prisión y logra que Anselmo Rodríguez lo ayude. Así es que visita a Sol. Giselle y Bárbara se ponen furiosas cuando se enteran de que Maricielo le ha ofrecido hospedaje a Miyogla en su misma casa, por lo que el miedo de perder a Cristo José crece en ambas. Rika, muy dolida y enojada, le confiesa a Sergio que ha descubierto su ex mujer está embarazada.

programme.desc: Doubt and disbelief plague the Stormhunters after an exhaustive chase through Tornado Alley. The team is forced to make an uncomfortable decision. Do they play it safe or push past their fear?

programme.title: Storm Hunters
programme.desc: While in Nepal, the Stormhunters receive unexpected news that literally takes this trip to the next level. They contend with mountainous terrain, adverse weather and altitude sickness in their quest to glimpse Earth's highest mountain.

programme.title: Storm Hunters
programme.desc: The North Atlantic Ocean is generous with her bounty, until she takes a life in return. Mark braves the deep seas on the most dangerous day of the lobster fishing season.

programme.title: Full Force Nature
programme.desc: An endless string of heavy rain storms in the Midwest sends a popular vacation spot down the drain

programme.title: Full Force Nature
programme.desc: A rain soaked town hits its limit, turning a tiny creek into a raging rapid.

programme.title: Mission: Hurricane
programme.desc: In 2019, Josh Morgerman chased Hurricane Dorian in the Bahamas in what wound up becoming one of the most intense and dangerous storms he has ever encountered.

programme.title: Mission: Hurricane
programme.desc: In this episode, we recount three of Josh Morgerman's most intense chases throughout the country of Taiwan, and witness his years of experience aid him in avoiding catastrophe a world away.

programme.title: Sinister Storms
programme.desc: Discover the different types of wrecking winds and the menace they can cause.

programme.title: Sinister Storms
programme.desc: Witness the uncertainty of nature, leaving you shocked and surprised at the same time.

programme.title: Viral Wild
programme.desc: What good is the warmth of summer, without the cold of the Winter.

programme.title: Viral Wild
programme.desc: Far from the reaches of human society, the animal kingdom thrives.

programme.title: Storm Hunters
programme.desc: Adventurer George Kourounis’ patience is tested as he encounters deadly wildlife and challenging elements while preparing to descend into Marum Volcano in the South Pacific.

programme.title: Storm Hunters
programme.desc: Stormhunters embark on their most epic tornado chase ever, breaking their own records and catching once in a lifetime views. ⇥

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Bigmouth steals the Smurfs' winter food supply and Brainy concocts one of Papa Smurf's magic strength potions so he can fight the greedy giant. The super formula wears off, but Papa Smurf works a fast switch, replacing the food with rocks and Bigmouth is none the wiser.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha turns herself into a Smurf, plotting revenge on the little people for destroying her magic locket. Papa Smurf outwits her and banishes her from the forest once more.

programme.title: The Baby Smurf
programme.desc: Gargamel turns himself into a Baby Smurf, to be adopted by the Smurfette. He causes complete chaos in the Smurf Village when he tries to blow it up with a time bomb! Papa Smurf discovers his evil plot and uses the explosive to send the wizard back to his dismal castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs' winter food supply is destroyed and they journey to a distant castle in search of shelter. Initially, they think the castle is haunted, but after they solve the mystery of a greedy pack of rats, the grateful owner presents them with an abundance of food for their long winter.

programme.title: The Purple Smurfs
programme.desc: The purple fly bites Lazy and an epidemic starts that turns the little villagers into angry, purple Smurfs. Papa Smurf discovers that the pollen from a tuberose flower is an antidote and soon things are smurfy again.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy makes an enlarging potion that turns Hefty into human size. The big-little strong man captures Gargamel and brings him back to the Smurf Village where Papa Smurf magically causes Azrael to chase his master back to his dreary castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The underground trolls who want them to be their slaves capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf ingeniously frees them and then destroys the trolls' magic crystal ball that gives them power over the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In an effort to find out where the Smurfs' secret diamond stash is hidden, Gargamel pretends to be their friend. When he shows his true, wicked self, Papa Smurf works a magic spell to save his little Smurfs from the vicious clutches of the evil wizard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Lazy dreams he is on Paradise Island and free from all the work Papa Smurf inflicts on him. His fantasy turns into a nightmare that sends him eagerly back to work once more.

programme.title: The Abominable Snowbeast
programme.desc: Brainy and his friends organize a journey to Ice Mountain to pick the rare snow flower for Papa Smurf. They meet a terrifying snow beast that befriends them, due to Smurfette's kindness, and helps them find the tiny flower.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette has found a new friend, Laura, a six-year-old child whose parents live near the forest. Together, the two girls wander in the forest. But an old witch who lives in the forest catches them.

programme.title: Gormandizing Greedy
programme.desc: Greedy overdoes it. He's getting heavier and heavier until his weight puts him in jeopardy. The evil Gargamel is going to catch him... Can Greedy be saved by Papa Smurf?

programme.title: Head Over Hogatha
programme.desc: Valentine's Day. Hogatha, the witch, is at the pond picking spore rot when, by accident, one of Cupid's arrows hits her. Now she is going to fall madly in love with the first man she sees... And as luck would have it, that man is Gargamel himself. Will he succeed in having her catch all the Smurfs in one fell swoop and will Hogatha get out of her fell swoop?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf's had enough. The Smurflings and Sassette keep on telling tales about him with unpleasant results. He therefore concocts a magic formula, taken from Papa Smurf's books of spells, which makes the little Smurfs' tails grow longer and longer every time they tell tales. What he hasn't counted on is that Gargamel now has a way of catching the Smurflings.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the emergency call rings, all the Smurfs in the Village drop what they are doing and run to hear the news. But when Vanity Smurf calls for an assembly so that the Smurfs can admire his new hat, it is too much. They send him on his way out of the village, and Vanity has the bad luck of meeting Lofty, the Elf, who suggests a horrible mud bath...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is that strange talking frog that Morlock the Wizard sends all of Prince Theodore's soldiers to catch? Is it a demon frog, as he says, or something else? Truth will out when Smurfette and the Smurflings meet the frog. They help to change this frog back into Prince Theodore himself, for he's been the victim of a spell cast by Morlock.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every 500 years, Castle Captor appears and abducts innocent travelers. Grandpa takes off in his balloon for the castle, where he meets Nanny Smurf, who’s been missing for 500 years. They have only a short time to escape, or they’ll become permanent guests!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty, Handy, and Brainy lose Papa's telescope and Scour, the Lord of Lost and Found, finds it. The Smurfs say they'll trade anything to get it back, so Scour takes their most valuable possessions – handiness, heftiness and braininess. They journey to his domain to retrieve what was lost.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil warlock Nemesis shows up at the Wizards' Library to steal the knowledge from the Archives of Evil and so get the Long Life Stone. But it's Brainy who inadvertently saves the day when he switches Greedy's cookbook and Papa's spell book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Roommates Smurfette and Nanny are getting on each other's nerves, so the time has come for Nanny to have a house of her own. As Nanny and Smurfette trek off to find a house-warming plant, the others design the Smurfliest house for her.

programme.title: Can't Smurf The Music
programme.desc: There is nothing the sorceress Chlorhydris hates so much as love in the world. She would like to see all love banished from the face of the Earth, and she's going to start with music. She puts a spell on a magic horn so that it will suck the music out of every song... especially the Smurfs' songs. Helped by their friend Laconia, the Smurfs may be able to resist Chlorhydris' evil plan...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel has got hold of magical ectoplasmic crystal eggs that will enable him to change bodies with Papa Smurf. What better plan could there be? Disguised as Papa Smurf, he's going to lead all the Smurfs to his cauldron! But as fate would have it, Gargamel is changed into Puppy, the Smurf doggie...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's not every day you meet a talking flower. Especially not a character like Petaluma, a somewhat haughty bulb flower who Smurfette meets in the forest. Of course the delighted Smurfette takes Petaluma to the Village of the Smurfs... and starts a process that is going to endanger all of the Smurfs. Flowers, it seems, ought to be seen and not heard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Everybody can make a mistake. Take Papa Smurf, for instance. His new perfume-enhancing spray makes a rose smell like a thousand roses...but due to a whole series of misadventures it also makes all the Smurfs cry, moved to tears by the slightest of pretexts. While they sob, bawl, wail moan and whimper, the evil wizard Gargamel does not stand still...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Tonight is talent show night in the Village of the Smurfs. Grandpa Smurf is going to do magic tricks, Sassette is going to perform with her trained pet frog, Clumsy is going to try his hand at juggling... and Jokey Smurf has made a dummy of Gargamel that he is sure will frighten the Smurfs out of their wits. But the real Gargamel finds a way to animate Jokey's dummy and then...

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Baby Smurf has lost all interest in toys. Even Jokey's surprises fail to amuse the tiny tyke. Grandpa Smurf suggests they go and pay a visit to the Toymaker, the one who makes toys for children all over the world. Or rather used to make: the Toymaker is tired of the lack of appreciation his toys receive from those who receive them.

programme.title: Handy's Window-Vision
programme.desc: Miner Smurf leaves no stone unturned and this is how he discovers a crystal that transmits images. Thus Handy is able to invent window-vision and, every morning from then on, the Smurfs are able to watch Hefty's workouts, Farmer Smurf's crop reports or even the Brainy Smurf Hour. But would you believe it? The evil wizard Gargamel takes advantage of this image-watching to catch Smurfs!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf has been elected Wizard of the Year, and the evil wizard Gargamel is beside himself with jealousy. He will see to it that Papa's powers all disappear. And then, he is sure to catch all the Smurfs and celebrate with a big feast... But now, would Papa Smurf let such a bad thing happen? Surely not, Papa finds a way to foil Gargamel's plan...

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sweepy the chimney sweep Smurf is not the most popular inhabitant of the Village of the Smurfs. He is rather messy, and the clouds of soot that he makes certainly don't add to his popularity. Only the Smurflings find him great company as he's the only one who can get dirty and not be told off. Yet in their enthusiasm for Sweepy, the Smurflings endanger the Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy learns it’s better to have smurfed than not to have smurfed at all when he learns his true love is really a mermaid. Can they really live with each other forever?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel asks the sorcerer Balthazar for a recipe to capture the Smurfs. It involves kidnapping Mother Nature to stop the arrival of Spring. Luckily, the Smurfs save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover the spirit and joy of friendly competition when they hold their first "Smurfic Games". After a near miss with the troublesome cat Azrael, the Smurfs decide they need to get into better shape. Papa Smurf suggests that the Smurfs tone their bodies as well as sharpen their athletic abilities by inaugurating the "Smurfic Games".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy Smurf's misadventures take him across a river into Pussywillow Hollow. There he meets the Pixies – charming and shapely beings whose enemies, the Wartmongers, will meet the Smurfs in some unforeseen ways.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Growing, harvesting and preparing food takes up much of the Smurfs' time. Handy invents a machine that farms and processes food. But this wonderful invention has its drawbacks...

programme.title: S-Shivering S-Smurfs
programme.desc: Winter has come all of a sudden. The Smurfs are almost all victims of smurfmonia. Can Tracker Smurf find the healing smurfroot without falling into the evil Gargamel's traps?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is the dramatic, moving story of the friendship between Smurfette and her pet mouse. A sad event reduces Smurfette to tears... Can the Smurfs comfort the despairing Smurfette?

programme.title: It Came From Outer Smurf
programme.desc: Dreamy wants to encounter beings from outer space so much that no one believes him when he talks of having met one. Yet the arrival of this extraterrestrial is going to wreak havoc in the Smurf Village...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has saved Clumsy from a horrible fate. Clumsy swears eternal devotion to his savior and does his best to repay his debt… With awkward results. A clever scheme is needed to stop Clumsy's well-meant catastrophes...

programme.title: Revenge Of The Smurfs
programme.desc: A war is raging in the Middle Ages. Knights in armor in hot pursuit inadvertently destroy the Smurfs Village so a small band of Smurfs decide to avenge this wrongdoing. Won't Papa Smurf think this is too human-like a reaction?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel has found a new diabolical scheme to get rid of the Smurfs: a glittering powder that is going to reduce them to helpless laughter...

programme.title: The A-Maze-Ing Smurfs
programme.desc: Jokey Smurf is dying to meet Melchior the Magnificent, creator of the famous Vanishing Box trick. Can Gargamel catch the Smurfs in Melchior's Amazing Maze?

programme.title: Smurf Van Winkle
programme.desc: Lazy Smurf is getting too lazy. The other Smurfs decide to play a trick on him: when he wakes up, he is surrounded by wrinkled, elderly Smurfs who tell him he has been sleeping for several centuries...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Scaredy Smurf runs into the Village screaming about the sky being about to smurf down. And just at the same moment, Papa Smurf is beset by uncontrollable fits of sneezing...

programme.title: Turncoat Smurf
programme.desc: Would you believe Brainy Smurf is the one who led the evil Gargamel to the Village of the Smurf? Of course he did not. But the others suspect him...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What a strange stone Clumsy has unearthed! In it, he can see events that are going to happen... Yet knowing part of the future sometimes brings bad luck!

programme.title: Heart Of Gold
programme.desc: Whatever Brainy Smurf says, the Clockwork Smurf devised by Handy has feelings just like any normal blue Smurf. At least it seems to be so until Clockwork Smurf loses what Handy had fitted inside its ribcage: a heart of gold. When the evil wizard Gargamel and his apprentice Scruple find the tiny contraption and fit it with a heart of stone, the Smurfs are in for a bad time...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: The Village Vandal
programme.desc: Nasty wizard Gargamel has had enough of the Smurfs' permanent superiority. He decides to destroy their Village once and for all. This is why he trains a termite to ravage, demolish, devastate and raze all the houses in its path. But the effect is even worse than Gargamel imagined as the Smurfs think that their Village is being torn apart by the antics of the Smurflings.

programme.title: Master Scruple
programme.desc: Farmer Smurf is the reluctant master of a genie named Gourdy, whose enthusiasm for service is somewhat excessive. After yet another incident due to Gourdy's overzealousness, Farmer Smurf says something he shouldn't and Gourdy disappears. And guess who finds him? Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: An evil imp gives Smurfette dancing shoes and then tricks her into promising to marry him. All her little friends rush to her rescue and Papa Smurf magically puts the dancing shoes on the imp. He is forced to dance off into the night.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sir Hefty discovers a wayward knight to help him defeat a dragon whose fire is threatening to destroy the forest. Alas, the knight proves to be a coward, leaving Hefty to prove just how brave he is when he sends the dragon away from Smurf Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy and Smurfette are captured by the wicked Bombast, who plans to exhibit them in his sideshow. Papa Smurf hurries to their rescue and using the bungling Gargamel for interference is able to rescue his Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Because they feel unappreciated, Poet and Painter leave Smurf Village and head for Storm Island, totally unaware that Gargamel is planning to trap them. Papa Smurf and his faithful volunteers rescue their friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: King Argon is a burly, boorish brute, but his wizard Mordain is worse still. He plans to use several Smurfs he has captured to steal all of the King's gold...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being asked to go to the Marsh to bring back the rare Foxfire is a great honor for a Smurf. But Scaredy Smurf is reluctant to confront the Marsh Monster so he sends the Smurf who cannot say no.

programme.title: The Smurfs
